title: Delivered units in the South
task: Sum Units (F2:F41) where Region is "South" and Status is "Delivered".

title: Revenue-weighted: units over 5 for Gadgets
task: Sum Units where Product is "Gadget" and Units is greater than 5.

title: Pending orders in the West
task: Count orders where Region is "West" and Status is "Pending".

title: Orders in Q1 2024
context: Date criteria need the comparison joined to a DATE.
task: Count orders with Date (B2:B41) on or after 1 Jan 2024 and on or before 31 Mar 2024.

title: Average price of delivered Electronics-priced items
context: Average UnitPrice for delivered orders priced above 50.
task: Average G2:G41 where Status is "Delivered" and UnitPrice is greater than 50.

title: Biggest North order
context: Largest unit count in the North region.
task: Return the maximum Units where Region is "North".

title: Total revenue
context: Revenue is Units × UnitPrice summed over every order — without a helper column.
task: Return the sum of F2:F41 multiplied row-by-row with G2:G41.

title: Delivered revenue
context: Only delivered orders count as revenue.
task: Return SUMPRODUCT of (H2:H41="Delivered") × F2:F41 × G2:G41.

title: Revenue for one rep
task: Return SUMPRODUCT of (D2:D41="Ana Silva") × (H2:H41="Delivered") × F2:F41 × G2:G41.

title: Cost via INDEX/MATCH
task: Return the Cost (L2:L9) of the product in E3 using INDEX and MATCH on J2:J9.

title: Which rep has the highest target?
context: Look left: find the name from the max target.
task: Return the Rep name (N2:N7) whose Target (P2:P7) equals the maximum target.

title: Category with XLOOKUP
task: Return the Category (K2:K9) for the product in E4 using XLOOKUP, with "Unknown" if not found.

title: Rep's hire date
task: Return the HireDate (Q2:Q7) for the rep in D3 using XLOOKUP.

title: Order size band
task: For row 2 return "Large" if F2 > 8, "Medium" if F2 > 4, otherwise "Small".

title: Status code with IFS
task: For row 2: "D" if H2="Delivered", "C" if "Cancelled", "R" if "Returned", otherwise "P".
hint: IFS(c1, v1, c2, v2, c3, v3, TRUE, v4).

title: Safe lookup
context: Lookups on a bad key shouldn't show #N/A.
task: Return VLOOKUP of the text "Gizmo" in J2:L9 column 2 (exact), but show "Not listed" on error.

title: Extract first name
task: Return the text in D2 before the first space.

title: Extract last name
task: Return the text in D2 after the first space.
hint: MID or RIGHT with FIND and LEN.

title: Email from name
task: Return LOWER of D2 with the space replaced by ".", followed by "@datahub.io".

title: Formatted revenue
context: Show the row-2 order value with thousands separator and 2 decimals.
task: Return TEXT of F2*G2 formatted as "#,##0.00".

title: Month label
task: Return TEXT of B2 formatted as "mmm-yyyy".

title: End of month
context: Invoices are due at month end.
task: Return the last day of the month for the date in B2.

title: Due in 30 days
task: Return B2 plus 30 days.

title: Tenure in years
context: How long has the rep in N2 worked here as of TODAY()?
task: Return DATEDIF from Q2 to TODAY() in whole years ("Y").

title: Working days to ship
context: Assume orders 1001 and 1002; count business days between their dates.
task: Return NETWORKDAYS from B2 to B3 — treat the earlier date as start: use MIN(B2,B3) and MAX(B2,B3).

title: Quarter number
task: Return the quarter (1–4) of the date in B2.

title: Rank an order by units
context: Where does order 1001 sit by size?
task: Return the RANK of F2 within F2:F41 (largest = 1).

title: Third-largest order
task: Return the third-largest value in F2:F41.

title: Median units
task: Return the median of F2:F41.

title: Standard deviation of price
task: Return the sample standard deviation of G2:G41 rounded to 2 decimals.

title: Margin for one order
task: Return F2 × (G2 − Cost of E2 looked up from J2:L9 column 3).

title: Target hit?
context: Did Ana Silva's delivered revenue beat her target?
task: Return "Hit" if SUMPRODUCT((D2:D41="Ana Silva")*(H2:H41="Delivered")*F2:F41*G2:G41) >= her Target (XLOOKUP in N2:P7), else "Miss".

title: Standardise region text
task: Return C24 in Proper Case, trimmed.
